trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 and unhealthy across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Release history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent version healthy in production.
- **Action:** Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — rollback confirmed successful everywhere.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note that rolling back to v2.3.0 (a previously healthy production version) didn't require change-manager approval per policy. I'd recommend following up on the incident to identify the root cause in v2.3.1 before any re-release.
